name: BSP_MainMenuScreen_Register
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Vtable +10h of the main-menu screen at 00E198AC+58h. __thiscall(this), bare RET. Chains BSP_FrontEndScreen_Register (004F71D0), then calls its own virtual +14h (the layout binder 005861B0), writes two text-height derived floats into +2B0h and +2B4h from BSP_TextContext_GetNormalizedTextHeight and two 00AA6750 extents, hides the +470h sub-object through its virtual +34h, clears the map handle +110h and the float3 at +1A4h, sets +190h/+194h to 0.2 and 0.39, clears the campaign bytes +564h and +565h, and finally calls BSP_D3D9Renderer_ChangePresentationMode. docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREEN_UPDATE.md.

name: BSP_FrontEnd_IsIntroMovieActive
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. No arguments, returns a byte in AL, RET. Builds the 16h-character literal movies/midwaytheme.bik on the stack through BSP_NativeString_Resize and _memcpy, passes it to 004F8BA0, releases the temporary through the sized storage pool and returns 004F8BA0's byte unchanged. 004F8BA0 compares the name against the active clip through BSP_NativeString_EqualsInsensitive and 00AAC8E0. Exactly one caller, BSP_MainMenu_StartTitleMusic (005884A0), which skips the whole body when this is non-zero, so the title music does not start over the intro movie. See docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREENS.md.

name: BSP_MainMenu_BuildTopLevelPage
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(this), ECX = the main-menu screen 005902E0, no stack arguments. Opens the FE.main_menu layout through 00518D60, writes main-menu page 1 to 00E08874 at 00584B91, hides the object at this+2F0h through its virtual +34h, enables the one at this+1B8h through virtual +60h, then runs a seven-pass loop at 00584BF0..00584C70. Each pass allocates a list entry through 00AAB4C0, labels it with 00E087B8[i] through 00ABBE50, stores i into entry+0D8h and writes (00CEF77C[i] == 0) into the byte at entry+77h. The seven labels are FE.main_singleplayer, FE.main_multiplayer, FE.main_tacticallibrary, FE.main_options, globals.live, FE_pc.main_marketplace, FE_pc.main_quit; all seven enable bytes are 01 in this image. The eighth pointer, 00CEF6D4 FE.main_singleplayer_help, is past the loop bound. Ghidra types 00CEF77C as a pointer (PTR_DAT_00CEF77C); it is a byte array. See docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREENS.md. | Read to the instruction. __thiscall(this, bool select_first), RET 4 at 00584F44. The stack argument decides the highlight at 00584C2F: zero restores the cached selection 00E194C4, non-zero pushes 0, both through 00A9C7C0 on the list box at this+1B8h. The seven-pass loop at 00584BC3..00584C13 allocates each entry with 00AAB4C0(this+238h, 0), calls the entry virtual +34h with 1, writes enableTable[i] == 0 into entry+77h from the byte array 00CEF77C (SETZ at 00584BF2), labels it with 00E087B8[i] through 00ABBE50 and stores i at entry+0D8h. The item that index selects is dispatched later by 00588A80, not here. docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREEN_UPDATE.md.

name: BSP_MainMenu_StartTitleMusic
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. No stack arguments, ECX unused, RET with no operand, no return value. The shell loads ECX = *(00E198AC)+58h at 004E4271 and calls here at 004E4274, but the body never reads ECX: the only object it touches is the manager at 00E198AC, so this is a method on the +58h screen class whose body ignores its own this. This corrects docs/GAME_FRONTEND_ENTRY.md line 71, which reads it as a call into the +58h screen. Body: 005884B9 gives up when 00584A30 reports the intro movie active; 005884CB gives up when the manager +50h handle is already set; 005884D5 operator new(54h); 0058851C copies the manager +40h path (sound/music/titlescreen.fsb) into a temporary through 00426060; 00588528 the stream constructor 00A877D0; 00588537 stores the result into manager +50h, null included; 0058854A copies the native string global at 00E19504; 0058855C 00A867B0(stream, name), which reaches FMOD createStream; 0058859F 00A864F0(stream, *(float*)00F889A8, the music volume written by BSP_Application_Initialize at 0073DB76); 005885AD 00A85C20(stream). No null guard: a failed allocation still calls all three through null. Resolves the manager +50h handle that docs/FRONTEND_MANAGERS.md leaves provisional. See docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREENS.md.

name: BSP_MainMenu_OpenTacticalLibraryWithSelection
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this), ECX = the main-menu screen, no stack arguments, RET. Resolves two values (005806A0 then 005C27E0 at 005885D4, then 005806A0 again at 005885E4), writes them into *(00E198AC)+70h at +9Ch and +A0h with the byte at +A4h cleared, writes mode 5 at +94h and selector 63h at +98h, then calls BSP_FrontEndManager_PushInterfaceRequest (004CC460) with interface 0Bh and a null payload. 0Bh is the tactical library screen at manager +70h. Neither 005806A0 nor 005C27E0 was read, so what the two selection values are is unresolved. See docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREENS.md.

name: BSP_MainMenu_OpenTacticalLibrary
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. No stack arguments, RET. Calls BSP_FrontEndManager_PushInterfaceRequest (004CC460) with interface 0Bh and a null payload FIRST at 005886CA, and only then writes mode 4 at +94h and selector 63h at +98h of *(00E198AC)+70h. The reversed order relative to 005885D0 means a servicing pass running between the two would see the request with the previous mode still in place; whether that is reachable was not checked. No selection is written, so +9Ch/+A0h keep whatever the previous request left. See docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREENS.md.

name: BSP_MainMenu_ActivateTopLevelItem
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this = the main-menu screen), bare RET. Reads the list-box selection with 00A9C990(this+1B8h), caches it in 00E194C4 (one of the four dwords the constructor 005902E0 clears) and dispatches seven ways: 0 calls 00584F50 (page 2), 1 calls 005853C0 (page 3), 2 runs the Lua chunk luaLoadControlFunctionNames() through 006B8AD0 then 005886F0 (page 0Bh), 3 clears 00E19650 and enqueues state requests 6 then 14h through BSP_Game_RequestState, 4 calls XShowGuideUI(0), 5 calls XShowMarketplaceUI(BSP_XenonSystemManager_GetActiveUserSlot(0)) only when 00585B40 and 00585810 both pass, and 6 raises the FE_pc.main_quit_confirm modal through 00531B00 with callback 0057D3B0 then 00530C20 on the menu-command screen. The two request pushes at 00588AF9 and 00588B06 are counterexamples to the claim in docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREENS.md that no screen in this range produces on the game+5D8h deque; per docs/GAME_FRAME_CONTROL.md request 6 runs the manager virtual +0Ch and request 14h is BSP_Game_RaiseOptionsMenu. docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREEN_UPDATE.md.
